<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="" />{{rh|HOLY weeke. 122|THE GOSPEL|CHA. XIII.}}</noinclude>{{dropinitial|A|fl={{verse|chapter=13|verse=1}}}}ND {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=See the Annotations vpon S. Matthew c. 24.}}vvhen he vvent out of the temple, one of his Disciples saith to him, Maister, behold what maner of stones, and vvhat kinde of buildings.{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Mt. 24, 1. Lu. 21, 5.''}} {{verse|chapter=13|verse=2}}† And {{sc|Iesvs}} ansvvering, said to him, Seest thou al these great buildings? There shal not be left a stone vpon a stone, that shal not be destroied.

{{verse|chapter=13|verse=3}}† And vvhen he sate in Mount-oliuet against the temple, Peter and Iames and Iohn and Andrevv asked him apart, {{verse|chapter=13|verse=4}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=TVESDAY night.}}Tel vs, {{sup|‖}} vvhen shal these things be? and vvhat shal be the signe vvhen al these things shal begin to be consummate? {{verse|chapter=13|verse=5}}† And {{sc|Iesvs}} ansvvering began to say to them, See, that no man seduce you. {{verse|chapter=13|verse=6}}† for many shal come in my name saying that {{sup|‖}} I am he: and they shal seduce many. {{verse|chapter=13|verse=7}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=Great vvarres toward the later end.}}And vvhen you shal heare of vvarres and bruites of vvarres, feare not. for these things must be, but the end is not yet. {{verse|chapter=13|verse=8}}† For nation shal rise against nation and kingdom against kingdom, and there shal be earthquakes in places, and famines. These things are the beginning of sorovves. {{verse|chapter=13|verse=9}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=Much persecution of the faithful and Catholike men in the later end.}}But looke to your selues. For they shal deliuer you vp in Councels, and in Synagogs shal you be beaten, and you shal stand before Presidents and Kings for my sake, for a testimonie vnto them. {{verse|chapter=13|verse=10}}† And into al nations first the Gospel must be preached. {{verse|chapter=13|verse=11}}† And vvhen they shal leade you and deliuer you, be not careful before hand vvhat you shal speake: but that vvhich shal be giuen you in that houre, that speake ye. For it is not you that speake, but the holy Ghost. {{verse|chapter=13|verse=12}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=Great treacherie and many false brethren at the same time.}}And brother shal deliuer brother vnto death, and the father his sonne: and the children shal arise against the parents, and shal vvorke their death. {{verse|chapter=13|verse=13}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=Constancie and perseuerance necessarie in time of persecution.}}And you shal be odious to al men for my name. But he that shal endure vnto the end, he shal be saued.

{{verse|chapter=13|verse=14}}† And vvhen you shal see ''{{sup|‖}} the abomination of desolation'', standing vvhere it ought not (he that readeth, let him vnderstand) then they that are in Ievvrie, let them flee vnto the mountaines:{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Dan. 9, 27. 2. Thess. 2, 4.''}} {{verse|chapter=13|verse=15}}† and he that is on the house-toppe, let him not goe dovvne into the house, nor enter in to take any thing out of his house: {{verse|chapter=13|verse=16}}† and he that shal be in the field, let him not returne backe to take his garment. {{verse|chapter=13|verse=17}}† And vvo to them that are vvith childe and that giue sucke in those daies. {{verse|chapter=13|verse=18}}† But pray that the things chaunce not in the vvinter. {{verse|chapter=13|verse=19}}† For those daies shal be such tribulations as vvere not from the beginning of the creation that God created vntil novv, neither shal<noinclude>{{rh|||be.}}</noinclude>
